user: A separate general question: what is a SEPA transfer?
answer:
What I did
- I checked our knowledge base for the SEPA transfer definition and related fees.

What I found
- SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day.
- Verta SEPA fee (tariff): flat EUR 0.35, percentage fee 0%.

Context (for comparison)
- Internal transfers at Verta settle instantly (fee EUR 0.00).
- SWIFT transfers settle in one to five business days (fee: EUR 15.00 + 0.3%).

What happens next
- If you want to make a SEPA transfer now, tell me the beneficiary details and amount and I can prepare it for you.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Dispute handling process
## Provisional credit
Where the disputed amount exceeds EUR 50 and the reason code is a fraud code, a
provisional credit is applied within two business days. Provisional credit is
reversed if the dispute is later declined.

Notifications
## Delivery failures
If the registered email bounces three times the address is marked unverified
and statement delivery is suspended until it is corrected.

Transfer limits
## How the remainder is computed
The daily remainder equals the daily limit minus settled outgoing transfers
dated today. The monthly remainder equals the monthly limit minus settled
outgoing transfers in the current calendar month. A transfer is refused when
it exceeds either remainder.

Transfers
## Transfer types
Internal transfers move funds between Verta accounts and settle instantly.
SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day. SWIFT transfers
are used for other destinations and settle in one to five business days. Card
payments are outgoing payments to a merchant.
